segments.text: It all starts with vectors and matrices, the building blocks of linear algebra.
segments.visual_plan: Draw a 3D vector and a 2x2 matrix side by side. Highlight the vector in GREEN and the matrix in YELLOW.
segments.narration: It all starts with vectors and matrices, the building blocks of linear algebra.
segments.on_screen_notes:
Key Concepts:
$\vec{v} = (x, y, z)$
$A = \begin{bmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{bmatrix}$

segments.text: Linear transformations can be represented using matrices, allowing us to change and manipulate vectors.
segments.visual_plan: Animate the matrix multiplying the vector, resulting in a new transformed vector. Highlight the transformation in RED.
segments.narration: Linear transformations can be represented using matrices, allowing us to change and manipulate vectors.
segments.on_screen_notes:
Linear Transformation:
$\vec{v}' = A \vec{v}$
$A = \begin{bmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{bmatrix}$
segments.visual_instruction: Animate the matrix multiplying the vector, resulting in a new transformed vector. Highlight the transformation in RED.
